$schema.description: Editor hint only; ignored by the loader.

id.description: `inscription-<slug>`; for a book, the id of its inventory item.

title.description: Title on the cover (at most 40 characters, as the item's), or heading of a note or inscription (at most 60).

author.description: Who wrote it, in the world; required for a book, optional for the others.

notes.description: Author-facing: bible section it comes from, who it contradicts, what it hints.

locations.description: Where it can be found: one or more glossary place ids (at least one).

text.description: The page as the reader shows it; plain text, paragraphs split by a blank line.

pages.description: The text, in page order; a note or inscription is usually one page.

evidence.description: Evidence tags (mw-e39.23): the `evidence.*` facts that holding this text proves. Quest and dialogue conditions read the fact; the text names it so the two stay together.

damaged.description: True exactly when the text carries `[illegible]` or `[missing]` markers.

description: A carved, painted or chalked inscription (mw-e39.13).
